rejected_alternatives.title: Redact or replace the entire Config.Env array or a credential block
rejected_alternatives.why: Unnecessary for push safety. GitHub flagged two exact credential types at raw-cloud-container.txt:6, corresponding to DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and GROQ_API_KEY. Per-field substitution of those values, plus the already-redacted DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, is sufficient. Whole-array replacement would destroy lossless evidence: 29 non-secret Env entries (paths, model, mode, store-root, PYTHONPATH, ordinary identity IDs, the environment-name reference MEGAPLAN_RESIDENT_VOICE_TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY_ENV) would be lost or masked. If selected it would still require field-level accounting; it is not selected.
